story.title: Company Story
story.body:
PT Saneng was established in 2004 in East Jakarta with a focus on high-quality industrial painting services. Starting from a dedicated small team, we have grown into one of Indonesia's trusted industrial coating partners.
For two decades, we have completed hundreds of projects for clients in petrochemical, manufacturing, power generation, and infrastructure sectors — with safety and quality standards we never compromise.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To become Indonesia's leading industrial coating service company, known for quality, safety, and integrity.

items.one: Deliver precise and durable coating solutions for every industrial need
items.two: Prioritize work safety in every process and project location
items.three: Build long-term client relationships through honesty and excellent workmanship

safety.title: Safety First
safety.body: Safety guides every work decision, from surface preparation to final inspection.

quality.title: Uncompromising Quality
quality.body: We maintain standards for materials, application methods, and finishing results to match industrial needs.

integrity.title: Integrity in Every Project
integrity.body: Every commitment is delivered transparently, measurably, and accountably.
